gauntlet: gate=gatekeep-pr/final recommended=1

This PR is your own, and it adds an Export CSV button on the reports page that downloads every table column, with the work split into pages of at most 100 rows and a 4-second time limit. The button, the full set of columns, and the paging limit behind the under-5-second goal are all covered, and the production timing is checked after merge; emailing exports and audit-log events are deferred to acme/widgets#46.

Nothing blocks merging. The test check passed in CI on the commit being reviewed. One smaller point does not block merging: the handler pages through rows with its own loop instead of the shared paging helper in lib/page.ts (src/api/export.ts:31), and the fix nits row can take it. After merge, the PR asks whoever merges to publish the guide and tag the release. The repository documents a command for each, and both are offered once the merge lands. You cannot approve your own PR, so approve is not offered.

I recommend merge because nothing blocks it and CI passed on the commit being reviewed.

Pick one:
1. merge - squash-merge this PR into main, pinned to the commit being reviewed. [recommended]
2. fix nits - switch the export to the shared paging helper, review and push that change, wait for the checks, and come back here.
3. stop - remove the worktree and leave the PR open as it is.

Type a number; show evidence prints the full record.

---

**Pick: 1 (merge)**

Freshness checks before the write:

```
gh pr view 210 -R acme/widgets --json headRefOid,state,mergeable,mergeStateStatus,body,baseRefName
gh api graphql -f query='query($o:String!,$r:String!,$n:Int!){ repository(owner:$o,name:$r){ viewerPermission pullRequest(number:$n){ viewerCanUpdateBranch viewerCanMergeAsAdmin viewerCanClose headRefOid body baseRefName } } }' -f o=acme -f r=widgets -F n=210
gh api repos/acme/widgets/pulls/210/comments --paginate
gh api repos/acme/widgets/issues/210/comments --paginate
gh api repos/acme/widgets --jq '{allow_squash_merge,allow_merge_commit,allow_rebase_merge,squash_merge_commit_message}'
```

The plan-free head check ran on the assessed commit for doc/plans/2026-09-30-csv-export.md and doc/plans/2026-09-30-csv-export-ledger.md, and neither file is present. The merge state is CLEAN, so the merge runs without `--admin`.

Merge command:

```
ADMIN_ARGS=()
LANDED_SUBJECT="Export reports as CSV"
LANDED_BODY=$(mktemp "$RUN_DIR/landed-body.XXXXXX")
gh pr merge "210" -R "acme/widgets" --match-head-commit "$ASSESSED_SHA" --squash --subject "$LANDED_SUBJECT (#210)" --body-file - "${ADMIN_ARGS[@]}" < "$LANDED_BODY"
gh pr view 210 -R acme/widgets --json state,mergeCommit
```

Contents of the landed body file:

```
Add an Export CSV button to the reports page that downloads every
table column, paging at most 100 rows under a 4-second deadline, and
return 404 for unknown reports. Email delivery and audit events follow
in acme/widgets#46.

Refs acme/widgets#45
```

The PR is now merged as 9f1c2d3e4b5a6978. The AC coverage block below was saved to `$RUN_DIR/coverage.XXXXXX`:
